Bill.BriefDescription: Making unfunded mandates optional on local governments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state mandates on political subdivisions of thestate; and adding a new section to chapter 43.135 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.135 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A political subdivision may choose to comply with a requirement ofany nature imposed by the state, or any instrumentality of the state,if the total state funds provided to the political subdivision that maybe expended or are required to be expended by the political subdivisionto meet the requirement are not sufficient to pay for all the costs ofmeeting the requirement. If these state moneys are not sufficient, therequirement loses its mandatory nature and becomes a recommendation oroption for the political subdivision and a penalty may not be imposedon the political subdivision for failing to comply with therequirement. For the purposes of this section, "political subdivision" includesany local government, or taxing district created under state law.
